_instruction: News and updates for SD Lab. Each item has a short highlight that is shown initially and details revealed when clicked.

items.highlight: Two conference papers accepted: Photonics 2026 at IIT Hyderabad and IEEE AESPC 2026.
items.details: Anushree Dash's paper on label-free structural and biological characterization of mosquito larvae via digital holography has been accepted at the 17th International Conference on Fiber Optics and Photonics (Photonics 2026), IIT Hyderabad. The paper by Saurav Jena, Debarchana Sen and Dipashrita Das on a low-cost, single-camera approach to 3D imaging using a smartphone camera and a 3D-printed stand has been accepted at IEEE AESPC 2026.

items.highlight: Our two JSAP-Optica Joint Symposia 2026 papers are now online at Optica Publishing Group.
items.details: The papers by Saanvi Patankar and Saurav Jena on D-shaped photonic crystal fiber sensors, presented in Sapporo in September 2026, are now published in the JSAP-Optica Joint Symposia 2026 Abstracts by Optica Publishing Group.

items.highlight: Teams HoloBuoy and GEONETRA named in the national Top 30 at the DoT 5G Innovation Hackathon 2026; GEONETRA also won 'Best Idea (Special Mention)'.
items.details: Two SDlab teams from the KIIT School of Electronics Engineering, HoloBuoy (HAC-2026-1350) and GEONETRA (HAC-2026-0174), were selected among the national Top 30 in the 5G Innovation Hackathon 2026, organized by the Department of Telecommunications, Government of India. GEONETRA also received the 'Best Idea (Special Mention)' recognition. The teams received prototype development funding, presented their prototypes at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, from September 14 to 17, 2026, and showcased them at India Mobile Congress 2026. Students Narayan Aravind, Saurav Jena, Saanvi Patankar and Ustah Puspalak represented the teams.

items.highlight: Saanvi presents her research at the JSAP–Optica Joint Symposia 2026 in Japan.
items.details: Saanvi presented her research physically at the JSAP–Optica Joint Symposia 2026, held at the Sapporo Campus of Hokkaido University, Japan, from September 8–11, 2026. She was selected as a recipient of the JSAP–Optica Travel Award. Session: 4.1 Plasmonics and Nanophotonics. Paper Title: Optimization of a D-Shaped PCF Using Multiphysics for Sensing Applications. Program No.: 8a-A22-3. Presentation Type: Oral.

items.highlight: Saurav presents his accepted research paper online at the JSAP–Optica Joint Symposia 2026.
items.details: Saurav's research paper was accepted for presentation at the JSAP–Optica Joint Symposia 2026. He presented the work online during the 87th JSAP Autumn Meeting 2026, held September 8–11, 2026, at Hokkaido University, Sapporo, Japan. Session: 4.1 Plasmonics and Nanophotonics. Presentation: Surface Plasmon Activated D-Shaped ZEONEX PCF as Bio-Compatible Refractive Index Sensor. Program No.: 8a-A22-2. Presentation Type: Oral.
